description: This PHP source file defines the ChimeSDKMeetingsClient class within the Aws\ChimeSDKMeetings namespace. It extends AwsClient and provides method annotations for interacting with Amazon Chime SDK Meetings, including creating, deleting, and listing meetings and attendees, as well as managing transcription and tags.
